name: Bone Marrow Failure: Aplastic Anaemia, Red Cell Aplasia and Pancytopenia

reference.source: Robbins Basic Pathology 9th Edition (topic map; text rewritten, no verbatim copy)
reference.pathophysiology: Autoreactive T cells apoptose stem cells into fat while Fanconi repair failure breaks chromosomes; PIGA clones escape immune attack expanding GPI bare cells that complement lyses intravascularly, and parvovirus NS1 arrests erythropoiesis at pronormoblasts.
additionalDifferentials: Aplastic versus MDS by blasts and dysplasia
Fanconi versus acquired aplastic by anomalies and breakage
PRCA versus myelophthisis by white cells and tear drops
additionalInvestigations: Reticulocytes with marrow biopsy and cytogenetics
DEB breakage with telomere length in inherited failure
FLAER with Ham test in haemoglobinuria
